title: Cutaneous alpha-synuclein deposition informs autonomic function in individuals with early-stage multiple system atrophy
journal: Clinical Autonomic Research · Trujillo P, Mann L, Bellaire B, Freeman R, Levine T, Gibbons CH, Cooper A, Wong C, Stamler D, Claassen DO（范德堡大學醫學中心神經科；CND Life Sciences；貝斯以色列女執事醫療中心神經科；Alterity Therapeutics）· doi:10.1007/s10286-026-01235-y
tag: 生物標記 · 皮膚切片
note: → 17 名早期 MSA 病人的 12 個月縱貫研究，以皮膚切片量測皮膚神經的 α-突觸核蛋白沉積。結果：沉積量自基線至 12 個月追蹤時上升，且與姿勢性低血壓與自律神經症狀相關。作者結論為皮膚切片可作為侵入性較低的工具，用於輔助診斷、追蹤病程與臨床試驗的受試者分層。⚠️ n=17、無疾病對照組（未與帕金森病等其他突觸核蛋白病變比較），因此本研究無法說明此指標的鑑別診斷特異度；「與自律神經功能相關」是橫斷面相關性，不等於它能預測後續惡化速度。收錄理由：MSA 領域長年的結構性限制是確診仍須死後病理，而現行試驗的療效判讀高度倚賴 UMSARS 這類臨床評分；一個可重複取樣、能量到病理蛋白本身的週邊指標，正是本站同時追蹤的 α-突觸核蛋白 PET 示蹤劑（MODAG、Synusight）想解決的同一個問題，差別在於皮膚切片的技術門檻與成本遠低於 PET。另需揭露：作者群包含 Alterity Therapeutics 兩名任職者（Wong C、Stamler D），該公司 ATH434 為 MSA 在研藥物之一。

en.journal: Clinical Autonomic Research · Trujillo P, Mann L, Bellaire B, Freeman R, Levine T, Gibbons CH, Cooper A, Wong C, Stamler D, Claassen DO (Department of Neurology, Vanderbilt University Medical Center; CND Life Sciences; Department of Neurology, Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center; Alterity Therapeutics) · doi:10.1007/s10286-026-01235-y
en.note: → A 12-month longitudinal study in 17 people with early-stage MSA, using skin biopsy to measure α-synuclein deposition in cutaneous nerves. Deposition increased from baseline to the 12-month visit and correlated with orthostatic hypotension and autonomic symptoms. The authors conclude that skin biopsy may serve as a minimally invasive tool to support diagnosis, monitor progression and stratify participants in clinical trials. ⚠️ With n=17 and no disease-control arm — no comparison against Parkinson's disease or other synucleinopathies — the study cannot speak to this measure's specificity for differential diagnosis; the association with autonomic function is cross-sectional and does not establish that it predicts the rate of subsequent decline. Why it is included: the standing structural limitation in MSA is that definitive diagnosis still requires post-mortem pathology, while trials read out largely through clinical scales such as UMSARS. A repeatably samplable peripheral measure that captures the pathological protein itself addresses the same problem as the α-synuclein PET tracers this site also tracks (MODAG, Synusight), at far lower technical cost. Disclosure: two of the authors are employees of Alterity Therapeutics (Wong C, Stamler D), whose ATH434 is one of the investigational agents in MSA.

title: Serum Trace-Element Profiles and Exploratory Composite Indices in Multiple System Atrophy: A Case-Control Study
journal: Diagnostics (Basel) 16(15):2420 · Aksoy Gündoğdu A 等（土耳其泰基爾達 Namık Kemal 大學醫學院神經科；伊斯坦堡 Aydın 大學醫學院神經科）· doi:10.3390/diagnostics16152420
tag: 生物標記 · 血清微量元素
note: → 30 名 MSA 病人對 30 名對照的病例對照研究，測定血清中 11 種微量元素。結果：MSA 組鋁與銅較高、鐵與鋅較低；作者自建的金屬負荷指數（Metal Burden Index）在 MSA 組較高，且經年齡與性別校正後仍與 MSA 狀態相關。⚠️ 作者自陳為探索性研究，並明言結果需在「疾病對照」與多中心世代中驗證——這裡的「疾病對照」是關鍵缺口：本研究的對照組非帕金森病等其他神經退化疾病，因此無法判斷這個型態是 MSA 特有，還是神經退化的共通伴隨現象。樣本數 30 對 30 亦屬小規模，複合指數在自身資料上建構、未經獨立驗證，通常會高估其分辨能力。收錄理由：鐵代謝失衡是本站追蹤中的機轉假說之一——Alterity ATH434 的作用機轉即為調節腦內鐵的分布。但兩者不可直接相連：本研究量的是血清鐵並發現偏低，而該假說關切的是腦部特定區域的鐵沉積，血清濃度與腦內分布並非同一件事，本研究也未做任何影像或腦組織的對照。

en.journal: Diagnostics (Basel) 16(15):2420 · Aksoy Gündoğdu A et al. (Department of Neurology, Faculty of Medicine, Tekirdağ Namık Kemal University; Department of Neurology, Faculty of Medicine, Istanbul Aydın University, Turkey) · doi:10.3390/diagnostics16152420
en.note: → A case-control study of 30 people with MSA against 30 controls, measuring eleven trace elements in serum. Patients with MSA had higher aluminium and copper and lower iron and zinc; a composite Metal Burden Index constructed by the authors was higher in MSA and remained associated with MSA status after adjustment for age and sex. ⚠️ The authors describe the work as exploratory and state that the findings require validation in disease-control and multicentre cohorts — and the disease-control gap is the decisive one: the comparison group here is not Parkinson's disease or another neurodegenerative condition, so the study cannot show whether this profile is specific to MSA or a general accompaniment of neurodegeneration. At 30 versus 30 the sample is small, and a composite index derived and evaluated on the same data will typically overstate how well it separates groups. Why it is included: disturbed iron handling is one of the mechanistic hypotheses this site tracks — Alterity's ATH434 acts by redistributing iron in the brain. The two should not be joined directly: this study measures serum iron and finds it low, whereas that hypothesis concerns iron deposition in specific brain regions. Serum concentration and brain distribution are not the same quantity, and no imaging or brain-tissue comparison was performed here.

title: Clinicopathologic mismatch in young-onset parkinsonism: Multiple system atrophy masquerading as a neurotransmitter synthesis disorder
journal: Clinical Neuropathology · Newman JM 等 · doi:10.5414/NP301756
tag: 診斷 · 臨床病理不一致
note: → 一例年輕發病帕金森症候群的臨床病理不一致案例：病人生前被診斷為神經傳導物質合成障礙（一類多屬可治療的遺傳性代謝疾病），死後病理才確認實為 MSA。⚠️ 單一個案報告，不能推論此類誤診的發生率。 收錄理由：MSA 好發於 50–60 歲，年輕發病者本就罕見，本例顯示在非典型年齡層，MSA 可以完全落在臨床鑑別診斷的視野之外。這與本站已收錄的德文綜述指出的同一個結構性問題相扣——確診至今仍只能靠死後病理，臨床診斷準則在非典型表現上的敏感度有其上限。對疾病修飾療法的試驗設計而言，此類誤診方向（把 MSA 誤判為他病）意味著部分病人在可介入的早期階段從未被納入試驗族群。

en.journal: Clinical Neuropathology · Newman JM et al. · doi:10.5414/NP301756
en.note: → A clinicopathologic mismatch in young-onset parkinsonism: the patient was diagnosed during life with a neurotransmitter synthesis disorder — a class of largely treatable inherited metabolic conditions — and only post-mortem pathology established that the disease was in fact MSA. ⚠️ A single case report; no inference can be drawn about how often this misdiagnosis occurs. Why it is included: MSA typically presents in the fifties and sixties, so young-onset cases are rare to begin with, and this one shows that in an atypical age group MSA can fall entirely outside the clinical differential. That ties back to the structural problem named in the German-language review already on this site — definitive diagnosis still requires post-mortem pathology, and the clinical criteria have a ceiling on sensitivity for atypical presentations. For disease-modifying trial design, a miss in this direction (MSA mistaken for another disease) means some patients are never entered into the trial population during the window when intervention is still possible.

title: Multiple system atrophy（德文綜述）
journal: Fortschritte der Neurologie-Psychiatrie · Wilkens I, Katzdobler S, Bernhardt A, Höglinger G, Hopfner F（慕尼黑大學附設醫院神經科、德國神經退化疾病中心慕尼黑分部、慕尼黑系統神經學研究群 SyNergy，德國）· doi:10.1055/a-2877-5054
tag: 疾病綜述 · 診斷與研究方向
note: → 德語系神經科教學期刊的 MSA 綜述（線上先行）。整理現行共識：MSA 屬非典型帕金森症候群中罕見且進展快速的一種，臨床上合併帕金森症狀、小腦性共濟失調與自律神經失調；病理核心為寡突膠細胞內錯誤摺疊的 α-突觸核蛋白堆積所驅動的多系統神經退化。診斷依 MDS 診斷準則並輔以 MRI，惟確診仍僅能靠死後病理。目前尚無疾病修飾療法，處置以症狀治療與多科團隊照護為主；作者列出的研究優先方向為生物標記開發與針對 α-突觸核蛋白聚集及神經發炎的介入。⚠️ 本篇為綜述，非原始研究，不含新數據；德文撰寫。 收錄理由：可作為現行診斷準則與領域共識的引用點，「確診仍需死後病理」這一限制，正是本站追蹤中的多項影像與體液生物標記研究（如 MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 造影試驗）所要解決的問題。

en.journal: Fortschritte der Neurologie-Psychiatrie · Wilkens I, Katzdobler S, Bernhardt A, Höglinger G, Hopfner F (Department of Neurology, LMU Klinikum; German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases, Munich site; Munich Cluster for Systems Neurology, SyNergy, Germany) · doi:10.1055/a-2877-5054
en.tag: Disease review · diagnosis and research directions
en.note: → A review of MSA in a German-language clinical neurology journal (online ahead of print), summarising current consensus: MSA is a rare, rapidly progressive member of the atypical parkinsonian syndromes, presenting with a combination of parkinsonism, cerebellar ataxia and autonomic dysfunction, and driven pathologically by accumulation of misfolded α-synuclein in oligodendrocytes causing multisystem neurodegeneration. Diagnosis rests on the MDS criteria supported by MRI, while definitive confirmation remains post-mortem only. There are no disease-modifying treatments; management is symptomatic and multidisciplinary. The authors name biomarker development and interventions targeting α-synuclein aggregation and neuroinflammation as research priorities. ⚠️ This is a review, not primary research: it contains no new data, and is written in German. Why it is included: it serves as a citable statement of the current diagnostic criteria and field consensus, and the limitation it names — that definitive diagnosis is still post-mortem — is precisely the problem addressed by several imaging and fluid-biomarker efforts tracked on this site, such as the MODAG [11C]MODAG-005 imaging study.

title: Nutritional Factors and Weight Loss Predict Tracheostomy-Free Survival in Multiple System Atrophy
journal: Movement Disorders Clinical Practice · Asano Y, Bokuda K, Hayashi K 等（東京都立神經病院神經內科／東京都立府中療育中心，日本）· doi:10.1002/mdc3.70767
tag: 預後因子 · 營養與存活
note: → 回溯分析 215 名 MSA 病人，以無氣切存活期為終點檢驗營養指標的預測力。平均存活 3.3 年（標準差 2.0）。多變量分析顯示三個獨立危險因子：預後營養指數（PNI）偏低（HR 2.12，p = 0.018）、BMI 下降幅度較大（HR 2.90，p < 0.001）、UMSARS 第一部分第 2 項（吞嚥）分數較高（HR 1.59，p = 0.014）。作者結論：以 PNI 與 ΔBMI 衡量的營養狀態惡化，獨立於吞嚥困難嚴重度之外預測較短的存活期。⚠️ 單一國家、以醫院為基礎的回溯世代，非隨機分派亦非介入研究——本研究證明的是「相關與預測」，不是「補充營養可延長存活」。 領域意義：PNI 與 BMI 變化取自例行血液檢查與體重，取得成本遠低於影像或體液生物標記，可作為 MSA 試驗分層與存活分析的候選共變數。

en.journal: Movement Disorders Clinical Practice · Asano Y, Bokuda K, Hayashi K et al. (Department of Neurology, Tokyo Metropolitan Neurological Hospital / Tokyo Metropolitan Fuchu Medical Center for the Disabled, Japan) · doi:10.1002/mdc3.70767
en.note: → A retrospective analysis of 215 patients with MSA tested the predictive value of nutritional measures against tracheostomy-free survival. Mean survival was 3.3 years (SD 2.0). Multivariate analysis identified three independent risk factors: a lower prognostic nutritional index (PNI) (HR 2.12, p = 0.018), a greater decline in BMI (HR 2.90, p < 0.001) and a higher score on UMSARS Part I item 2, swallowing (HR 1.59, p = 0.014). The authors conclude that nutritional decline, captured by PNI and ΔBMI, predicts shorter survival independently of the severity of dysphagia. ⚠️ A single-country, hospital-based retrospective cohort — not randomised and not an intervention study. It establishes association and prediction, not that nutritional support extends survival. Field relevance: PNI and BMI change are derived from routine bloods and body weight, making them far cheaper to obtain than imaging or fluid biomarkers, and therefore candidate covariates for stratification and survival analysis in MSA trials.

title: Magnetic resonance imaging markers predict disease progression in early-stage multiple system atrophy: a 2-year prospective cohort study
journal: The Journals of Gerontology Series A · Zhang L, Lin J, Li C 等，通訊作者 Shang H（四川大學華西醫院神經內科／罕見病中心，中國）
tag: 影像生物標記 · 病程預測
note: → 前瞻世代收案 144 名早期 MSA 病人，依 MSA 專屬 MRI 標記分為影像陽性與陰性兩組，以 UMSARS 總分、蒙特婁認知評估與額葉功能評估追蹤兩年，73 人完成完整追蹤。結果顯示影像陽性組在整體 MSA 與帕金森亞型（MSA-P）的 UMSARS 總分惡化顯著較快（p = 0.002 與 p = 0.020）；校正年齡、性別與基線病程後，影像陽性狀態在第 1 年與第 2 年皆為病程惡化的顯著預測因子（皆 p < 0.05）。作者結論為 MRI 標記除診斷用途外，亦具病程預測價值。⚠️ 單一中心世代，144 人中僅 73 人完成兩年追蹤（流失約半數），且原文摘要未列出構成「影像陽性」的個別標記與判讀閾值；跨中心採用前需確認標記定義與掃描參數一致性。

en.journal: The Journals of Gerontology Series A · Zhang L, Lin J, Li C et al., corresponding author Shang H (Department of Neurology / Rare Diseases Center, West China Hospital, Sichuan University, China)
en.note: → A prospective cohort of 144 patients with early MSA was split into MRI-positive and MRI-negative groups on the basis of MSA-specific MRI markers and followed for two years using the UMSARS total score, the Montreal Cognitive Assessment and the Frontal Assessment Battery; 73 patients completed the full follow-up. The MRI-positive group progressed significantly faster on UMSARS total score, both for MSA overall and for the parkinsonian subtype MSA-P (p = 0.002 and p = 0.020). After adjustment for age, sex and baseline disease duration, MRI-positive status remained a significant predictor of more severe progression at both the 1- and 2-year visits (all p < 0.05). The authors conclude that MRI markers carry prognostic as well as diagnostic value in early MSA. ⚠️ A single-centre cohort in which only 73 of 144 patients completed two years of follow-up (roughly half were lost), and the published abstract does not specify which individual markers and thresholds constitute "MRI-positive"; marker definitions and acquisition parameters would need to be harmonised before multi-centre use.

title: Quantitative susceptibility mapping in neurodegenerative diseases: An umbrella review of iron-related biomarkers and mechanisms
journal: Magnetic Resonance Imaging · Ghaderi S, Mohammadi S, Iturria-Medina Y（蒙特婁神經學研究所／麥基爾大學，加拿大）
tag: 影像生物標記 · 定量磁化率造影
note: → 統合 15 篇系統性回顧的傘狀回顧，檢視定量磁化率造影（QSM）在各神經退化疾病作為鐵沉積生物標記的表現。與 MSA 直接相關的結論是：殼核與蒼白球的磁化率升高可有效區分多系統萎縮症與進行性核上性麻痺、和原發性帕金森氏症，QSM 在偵測病理性鐵累積上優於既有序列。⚠️ 為回顧之回顧、非原始影像資料，各原始研究的族群大小、判讀閾值與掃描參數不一致，臨床採用前仍需標準化。

en.journal: Magnetic Resonance Imaging · Ghaderi S, Mohammadi S, Iturria-Medina Y (Montreal Neurological Institute / McGill University, Canada)
en.note: → An umbrella review synthesising 15 systematic reviews on the performance of quantitative susceptibility mapping (QSM) as an iron-deposition biomarker across neurodegenerative disease. The finding of direct relevance to MSA: elevated susceptibility in the putamen and globus pallidus effectively separates multiple system atrophy and progressive supranuclear palsy from idiopathic Parkinson's disease, with QSM outperforming established sequences at detecting pathological iron accumulation. ⚠️ This is a review of reviews rather than primary imaging data; cohort sizes, thresholds and acquisition parameters differ across the underlying studies, so standardisation is still required before clinical adoption.

title: GATD3A-mediated monocyte homeostasis and compartmentalized erythrocyte alpha-synuclein discriminate early Parkinson's disease from MSA-P
journal: Frontiers in Immunology · Jiang Y, Xu C, Jin J 等（首都醫科大學附屬北京天壇醫院運動障礙中心／國家神經疾病臨床研究中心，中國）
tag: MSA-P 鑑別診斷 · 血液生物標記
note: → 納入 149 名受試者（帕金森氏症 75 人、MSA-P 74 人），尋找可在早期區分兩者的血液標記。臨床上 MSA-P 病人病程進展較快、自律神經衰竭較嚴重；分子層面，早期 MSA-P 的單核球呈現由趨化因子驅動的侵襲性促發炎型態，帕金森氏症則偏向保護性表現，而紅血球內 α-突觸核蛋白（含膜結合的寡聚體）在兩病間呈現不同的區室化分布。⚠️ 單中心世代、樣本數中等，尚未經獨立族群驗證；本文另有一則同期更正啟事（PubMed 42549319）。記錄價值：MSA-P 與帕金森氏症早期難以區分是此領域反覆出現的收案難題，可及的血液標記若能複製驗證，對縮短診斷時間與試驗篩選有實質意義。

en.journal: Frontiers in Immunology · Jiang Y, Xu C, Jin J et al. (Center for Movement Disorders, Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University / China National Clinical Research Center for Neurological Diseases, China)
en.note: → 149 participants (75 Parkinson's disease, 74 MSA-P) were studied to find blood markers that separate the two conditions early. Clinically, the MSA-P group progressed faster and had more severe autonomic failure; molecularly, monocytes in early MSA-P showed an aggressive, chemokine-driven pro-inflammatory profile where Parkinson's disease trended protective, and erythrocyte alpha-synuclein — including membrane-sequestered oligomers — was compartmentalised differently between the two diseases. ⚠️ A single-centre cohort of moderate size, not yet replicated in an independent population; a correction notice for this article was also published (PubMed 42549319). Why it is recorded: distinguishing early MSA-P from Parkinson's disease is a recurring recruitment problem in this field, and accessible blood markers, if replicated, would meaningfully shorten time to diagnosis and improve trial screening.

title: Early assessment, diagnosis and treatment of Parkinsonism and Related Syndromes study (ExPRESS): a protocol for an observational study on incident parkinsonism
journal: BMJ Open · Fumi RG 等（University College London／劍橋／布里斯托／牛津，英國）
tag: 世代研究 · 早期診斷
note: → 英國多中心前瞻性世代研究計畫書：招募 500 名新發帕金森症候群病人（須在首次專科門診後 12 個月內），其中 120 人於子站點接受深度生物標記評估（血液、部分收集腦脊髓液與皮膚切片、影像），並以病歷連結做終生追蹤。作者指出 MSA 自症狀發生到診斷的中位數為 3.1 年，遠長於帕金森氏症的 1.0–1.2 年；研究目標即改善 MSA 等非典型帕金森症候群的早期辨識，並建立可供疾病修飾治療試驗使用的「trial-ready」世代。

en.journal: BMJ Open · Fumi RG et al. (University College London / Cambridge / Bristol / Oxford, UK)
en.note: → Protocol for a UK multicentre prospective cohort recruiting 500 people with incident parkinsonism within 12 months of their first secondary-care appointment, with 120 participants at subset sites undergoing deep biomarker assessment (blood, and for some CSF and skin biopsy, plus imaging) and lifetime follow-up through medical-records linkage. The authors note that the median time from symptom onset to diagnosis is 3.1 years in MSA, against 1.0–1.2 years in Parkinson's disease; the study aims to improve early recognition of atypical parkinsonian syndromes such as MSA and to build a trial-ready cohort for disease-modifying treatments.

title: Cerebellar Atrophy Modulates Freezing of Gait in Multiple System Atrophy Through Cognitive Dysfunction
journal: CNS Neurosci Ther · Yang H 等（武漢大學人民醫院放射科）
tag: 影像 · 步態凍結與認知
note: → 106 名 MSA 病人（58 名有步態凍結 MSA-FOG、48 名無）以 FreeSurfer 與 SUIT 工具做小腦分區分割：MSA-FOG 組在執行功能、視空間、注意力、工作記憶、語言與延遲回憶皆有缺損，並見全小腦灰質與 I–X 分葉萎縮。迴歸顯示 Crus II 萎縮可獨立預測 N-FOGQ 分數，且執行功能與注意力缺損中介了 Crus II 體積減少與步態凍結嚴重度的關聯。作者提出小腦萎縮可作為 MSA 步態凍結的潛在影像標記。

en.journal: CNS Neurosci Ther · Yang H et al. (Department of Radiology, Renmin Hospital of Wuhan University)
en.tag: Imaging · freezing of gait and cognition
en.note: → In 106 MSA patients (58 with freezing of gait, 48 without), cerebellar lobules were segmented with FreeSurfer and the SUIT toolbox. The MSA-FOG group showed deficits in executive function, visuospatial ability, attention, working memory, language and delayed recall, alongside atrophy of global cerebellar grey matter and lobules I–X. Regression showed that Crus II atrophy independently predicted N-FOGQ scores, with executive-function and attention deficits mediating the association between reduced Crus II volume and freezing severity. The authors propose cerebellar atrophy as a potential imaging marker for freezing of gait in MSA.

title: Pre-Diagnostic Factors Associated with Coding-Based Incident Multiple System Atrophy: A Nested Case-Control Study of the UK Biobank
journal: Mov Disord · Zhao CW 等（Mass General Brigham／哈佛醫學院）
tag: 流行病學 · 風險因子
note: → UK Biobank 巢式病例對照研究：114 例編碼判定之新發 MSA、1,139 例年齡性別配對新發 PD、1,075 名對照。抗組織胺使用、飲酒與身體活動下降在加入 5／10 年潛伏期窗後衰減，提示反向因果；statin 使用於基線與 5 年窗與較低風險相關（OR 0.34，95% CI 0.17–0.69），但與「中度偏高膽固醇亦呈較低風險」（OR 0.41，95% CI 0.24–0.72）方向不一致。唯一隨潛伏期拉長而增強的暴露為居住鄉村（5 年窗 OR 2.73，95% CI 1.32–5.65）。作者結論 MSA 有長期前驅階段，鄉村居住值得進一步研究。

en.journal: Mov Disord · Zhao CW et al. (Mass General Brigham / Harvard Medical School)
en.note: → A UK Biobank nested case-control study of 114 coding-based incident MSA cases, 1,139 age- and sex-matched incident PD cases and 1,075 controls. Antihistamine use, alcohol use and reduced physical activity attenuated once 5- and 10-year latency windows were applied, suggesting reverse causation. Statin use was associated with lower risk at baseline and at 5 years' latency (OR 0.34, 95% CI 0.17–0.69), but this was discordant with the lower risk also seen for moderately elevated cholesterol (OR 0.41, 95% CI 0.24–0.72). Rural living was the only exposure whose effect strengthened with longer latency (5-year OR 2.73, 95% CI 1.32–5.65). The authors conclude MSA has a long pre-diagnostic phase and that rural living warrants further investigation.

title: Multiple system atrophy: cure and care
journal: J Neural Transm · Buonocore J 等（因斯布魯克醫學大學／LMU 慕尼黑／Magna Graecia）
tag: 綜論 · 診斷與照護
note: → 因斯布魯克 Fanciulli／Stefanova 團隊的領域綜論：整理自症狀發生起中位存活 8–10 年、寡樹突膠細胞內 α-synuclein 形成膠質細胞質包涵體的病理核心，以及新版診斷準則與生物標記進展；指出前驅期與其他 α-synuclein 病變重疊仍使早期診斷困難。並直言迄今以 α-synuclein 為標的的治療開發尚未展現一致的臨床效益，現階段管理仍以症狀支持為主，遠距醫療與多專科照護模式正在改變臨床實務。

en.journal: J Neural Transm · Buonocore J et al. (Medical University of Innsbruck / LMU Munich / Magna Graecia)
en.note: → A field review from the Innsbruck group (Fanciulli / Stefanova): median survival is 8–10 years from symptom onset, with α-synuclein accumulating in oligodendroglia as glial cytoplasmic inclusions at the pathological core; new diagnostic criteria and biomarkers have improved recognition, yet prodromal overlap with other α-synucleinopathies keeps early diagnosis difficult. The authors state plainly that α-synuclein-targeted therapeutic development has not yet shown consistent clinical benefit, that management remains largely supportive, and that telemedicine and multidisciplinary care models are reshaping practice.

en.journal: Cell · Zeng S et al.
en.note: → Reports that TPPP/p25 amyloid seeding activity can serve as a specific biomarker for MSA, helping distinguish it from other α-synucleinopathies (e.g. PD, DLB); a high-impact mechanistic/diagnostic advance for the field.

title: Validation of orthostatic hypotension in MDS diagnostic criteria for multiple system atrophy
journal: Eur Neurol · Yoshizaki S 等（日本）
tag: 診斷準則 · 姿勢性低血壓
note: → 451 人回溯性病歷比較（臨床可能 MSA 107、帕金森病 223、路易體失智 89、純自主神經衰竭 32）：以 2022 MDS 準則（收縮／舒張壓下降 >20／10 mmHg）判定，MSA 的姿勢性低血壓偵測率由 Gilman 準則的 39.3% 升至 64.5%（p<0.001），但同一準則在帕金森病（39.0%）、路易體失智（67.4%）與純自主神經衰竭（87.5%）也大量命中。收縮壓過衝（overshoot）在 MSA 僅 6.5%，顯著低於路易體失智 21.3%（p=0.002）與純自主神經衰竭 28.1%（p<0.001）。作者結論：MDS 準則對 MSA 的神經性姿勢性低血壓更敏感，而過衝頻率較低可協助與其他 α-synuclein 病鑑別，反映節後自主神經受損較輕。

en.journal: Eur Neurol · Yoshizaki S et al. (Japan)
en.note: → A retrospective chart review of 451 patients (clinically probable MSA 107, Parkinson's disease 223, dementia with Lewy bodies 89, pure autonomic failure 32): applying the 2022 MDS criteria (a fall of >20/10 mmHg systolic/diastolic) raised detection of orthostatic hypotension in MSA from 39.3% under the Gilman criteria to 64.5% (p<0.001), but the same criteria also flagged large fractions of Parkinson's disease (39.0%), dementia with Lewy bodies (67.4%) and pure autonomic failure (87.5%). Systolic overshoot occurred in only 6.5% of MSA, significantly less than in dementia with Lewy bodies (21.3%, p=0.002) and pure autonomic failure (28.1%, p<0.001). The authors conclude that the MDS criteria detect neurogenic orthostatic hypotension in MSA more sensitively, and that the lower overshoot rate may help separate MSA from other synucleinopathies, reflecting less prominent postganglionic autonomic impairment.
